source:
class A:pass
def read(key):return key+1
A.__class_getitem__=read
print(A[3],A.__class_getitem__ is read)
A.__class_getitem__=classmethod(lambda cls,key:(cls.__name__,key))
print(A[5])
del A.__class_getitem__
try:A[0]
except TypeError:print('missing')

name: late-unbound-function
